Rank 11 - Hospitality

Micro Hotel and Guesthouse Room Manager

Owners need room status, due, booking hold, cleaning, and cash visibility across shifts.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 15,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 700Recommended monthly charge

BDT 700/month is reasonable because owners buy shift accountability and room control.

7.9Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 15,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 700Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 11,700,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target guesthouses, lodges, rest houses, and hotels near hospitals, stations, and district markets.

Room status and cash are split across notebooks, and staff can hide leakage.

Every room has a status and owner sees cash without calling the counter.

Validation signals

  • Accommodation exists in every district town.
  • Room leakage is direct owner pain.
  • Higher setup fee is possible.
  • Old phone/tablet can run the room board.

MVP modules

  • Room grid
  • Check-in/check-out
  • Booking hold
  • Guest note
  • Payment and due
  • Housekeeping status
  • Daily occupancy report

Do not build first

  • Do not become Booking.com.
  • Do not add OTA integration first.
  • Do not make legal promises.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Sell to guesthouses near hospital/station.
  • Set up room map.
  • Train both shifts.
  • Add owner dashboard later.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Staff resistance.
  • Guest identity rules.
  • Custom room rates.
Mitigations
  • Owner-only audit log.
  • Printable register.
  • Simple rate rules.
